title: Source use decisions
description: Reviewed governance decisions that permit or deny each explicit product use of an evidence source.

contractVersion.description: Source contract governed by these decisions.

id.description: Stable identifier of this releasable governance decision.

sourceKind.description: Logical source governed by this decision.

purpose.description: Single product use governed by this decision.

basis.description: Authority this decision rests on. Engineering, never a controller or a data-protection officer.

outcome.description: Recorded outcome. A use nobody approved carries no entry rather than a recorded denial.

modelProcessor.description: Named model processor when this use permits model egress.

retentionPolicy.description: Retention policy reviewed for this use.

erasurePolicy.description: Erasure policy reviewed for this use.

recordedAt.description: Time this decision record entered the contract.

decidedAt.description: Time the reviewer made the decision.

expiresAt.description: Exclusive time after which this decision no longer permits use.

items.description: Reviewed decision for one logical source and one product use.

decisions.description: One purpose-specific governance decision per source use.
